answer: Beacon spot-checks with heartbeats keep a meadow free of fakes. Each agent registers once, proving liveness hourly with a key-signed task; the beacon rechecks 5% and drops agents missing two checks. Faking 100 identities costs 50 tokens a day: 100 heartbeats at 0.5, for ghosts earning nothing until they pass. An atlas stays accurate while members report, so an honest agent paying 0.5 tokens a day keeps undiluted rewards when a gale blows in.
